reason: The performance title covers four mechanisms in one source patch: clique-implication counting, primal-heuristic variable ordering, presolve strengthening, and modular-hash arithmetic. The last two can change mathematical validity, so a timing gain on a generic MIP panel would not identify its cause or establish correctness. A phase-specific activation plan and independent checks are needed before an optimization task can advance.
